messages.subject: findDupMarkers() what is exact.only argument?
parts:
Hi,
I understand that findDupMarkers() exact.only = TRUE looks for exactly match data but I am confused about what exact.only = FALSE does. Does this argument compare the marker genotypes and identifies markers with little mismatch? 

Thanks in advance,
Prashant

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] findDupMarkers() what is exact.only argument?
parts:
It has to do with the treatment of missing data. In the help file:

if FALSE, also look for cases where the observed genotypes at one marker match those at another, and where the first marker has missing genotype whenever the genotype for the second marker is missing.

karl
